source: Approved GUIDELINES 2.5 core uses and per-language NetScript Mapping/node bindings; explicit paint stacks composite over the preset ground.

decorativeRoles.liquid-on-accent-rim: White translucent inset stroke on an accent control, not label text.
decorativeRoles.liquid-on-accent-rim-strong: Stronger white translucent accent-control rim, not label text.
decorativeRoles.liquid-switch-on-track: The switch on-state track uses on as a state name, not an on-color label role.
decorativeRoles.liquid-switch-on-edge: The switch on-state edge uses on as a state name, not an on-color label role.
decorativeRoles.fluent-stroke-on-accent: An accent-control decorative stroke, not text on the accent fill.

usageNotes.fluent-focus-inner: The 1px inner focus line is decorative in the approved 2px outer + 1px inner anatomy. The outer indicator and core ring are measured against base/layer/control backgrounds; the inner line is not a standalone focus indicator.
usageNotes.terminal-component-key: These component tokens alias the Terminal-owned key variant; its actual consumers are measured in Terminal.
usageNotes.alpha: Background layers paint over the opaque preset ground. Native oklch values and alpha are measured before hex serialization.
